titulo: VITACHY 2-in-1 Kitchen Soap Dispenser and Sponge Holder, Large 15oz Dish Soap Pump with Sink Caddy Organizer, Ergonomic One-Hand Operation for Arthritis, Detachable Countertop Soap Mount, Black
bullets: 🧼 ULTIMATE SINK ORGANIZATION: Streamline your kitchen with this all-in-one caddy. Features dedicated slots for sponges, dishcloths, and brushes, keeping your countertop dry, tidy, and clutter-free.

👐 EFFORTLESS ONE-HAND PUMP: Designed for efficiency and comfort. The smooth-motion piston allows for easy soap dispensing with one hand—perfect for seniors or those suffering from arthritis and joint pain.

🔄 VERSATILE DETACHABLE DESIGN: Use the soap pump and the organizer tray together or as separate units. Both pieces feature non-slip TPR bases to ensure they stay firmly in place even on soapy surfaces.
📦 EXTRA LARGE 15OZ CAPACITY: Spend less time refilling. The 450ml reservoir holds twice as much as standard dispensers, while the precision pump prevents soap waste and saves you money.
💪 DURABLE & EASY TO CLEAN: Made from high-impact HIPS and chemical-resistant PP. The entire unit snaps apart easily for a thorough cleaning, ensuring a hygienic environment for your dishes.
descripcion_html:
Dish Soap Dispenser with Storage Tray
Product Advantages
  • One-Handed Soap Dispenser: The soap dispenser head glides smoothly down while the pump dispenses just the right amount of dish soap. Ideal for the elderly, it requires minimal force. Simplifies the task.
  • Modern and Compact Design: Fits any kitchen style. Takes up little counter space. Keeps the area clean and tidy.
  • Large Capacity: The dish soap reservoir has a capacity of 450ml, almost half a litre. Double that of other soap dispensers while occupying the same space. Technically superior design: better dispensing mechanism, smoother, and double the capacity.
  • Easy Assembly and Disassembly: The dispenser can be assembled and disassembled by hand, without tools, for complete cleaning when necessary.
  • Independent Tray with Compartment: The soap dispenser can be used alone or on a tray provided with the product. The tray has a compartment for storing the cloth, brush, or sponge. Both elements have anti-slip bands.

High-Quality Material
  • HIPS Casing: The casing is made of HIPS (High Impact Polystyrene), a material known for its mechanical and chemical resistance. The dispenser is built to last, with a robust and unalterable structure.
  • TPR Anti-Slip Bases: TPR (Thermoplastic Rubber) is a blend of rubber and plastic that produces flexible materials resistant to heat, chemicals, and wear.
  • PP Soap Tank: Polypropylene (PP) is a polymer resistant to all types of chemicals, including soap, making it an ideal material for the reservoir. PP is durable, lightweight, and does not absorb water.

Environmental Contribution

Using reusable dispensers significantly reduces plastic waste worldwide. The problem is not the use of plastic, but its abuse. Plastic is, objectively, one of the best materials to withstand aggressive conditions of heat, humidity, and chemicals without oxidation or corrosion, and to endure severe impacts. Without plastic, our quality of life would not be the same. On the other hand, the abuse of small, non-reusable plastic containers is causing serious environmental problems. We must transition to a model that uses fewer small single-use containers and increasingly functional devices to dispense the product.


Convenience

It is much more convenient to use a dispenser than to pour dish soap directly from the bottle. This is especially true for the elderly, who may not have as much hand strength. Kitchen soap dispensers are a transition towards convenience, just as the shift from hand soaps to dispensers was. Dispensers also make sense in the kitchen and lighten our workload a bit. It is not the same to pour soap from the bottle as to press a pump with your hand. Plus, it frees up counter space by eliminating the bottle.


Assembly and Maintenance Tips
  • Product Assembly: The dispenser parts fit together perfectly without the need for flaps or screws. It can be assembled and disassembled by hand with minimal force.
  • Cleaning Tip: To maintain the shine and appearance of the dispenser, clean it with a soft cloth and avoid using scouring pads or elements that could scratch the surface. This way, it will look like new for many years.
